Breakout Game

Classic Breakout on canvas — real ball physics, 5 rows of bricks, 3 lives, score, and speed-up levels.

📖 How to use

  1. Move the paddle with mouse, touch, or ←/→.
  2. Launch the ball with Space or a tap.
  3. Break every brick to advance levels.
  4. Don't let the ball past your paddle — 3 lives!

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I control the paddle?

Mouse, touch-drag, or ←/→ arrow keys. Press Space or tap to launch the ball.

How does scoring work?

Bricks are worth 10 points each; clearing the board advances a level and speeds up the ball.

How many lives do I get?

You get 3 lives. Missing the ball costs one; losing all three ends the game.

Does it get harder?

Yes — the ball speeds up and bricks reset each level.
